headline: Russell Brand sentenced to more than 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assault

members.title: Russell Brand to be sentenced for rape and sexual assault today – latest updates
members.lead: Disgraced comedian was convicted last week and was warned he faces a ‘signficant’ prison term Following his conviction last week, the Met Police revealed that they were investigating further rape allegations against Brand, including one involving a then 16-year-old girl. The Met said they had already questioned Brand on further complaints from two other women, and have submitted the files to crown prosecutors. If you get a conviction then it tends to encourage other people to come forward because they see the courage and the bravery and the resilience that these women have had to go through this criminal justice process, and they feel their own strength as a result of that. They want to come forward and have their story told. Continue reading...

members.title: Russell Brand sentenced to more than 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assault
members.lead: Disgraced actor and comedian, 51, was described as a ruthless and manipulative sexual predator during trial Russell Brand sentencing – live updates Russell Brand has been sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison for raping a fan and sexually assaulting three other women at the height of his showbusiness career. Brand, 51, was found guilty after a four-week trial at Southwark crown court in which he was described as a ruthless and manipulative sexual predator. Continue reading...
